procedural_matters: Hearing No. 40 was heard together with hearing No. 39, in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The technical committee was represented by Ulrich Vogelmaier (member of the technical committee).
GER 926 was represented by Tobi Schrage (helm).
GER 923 did not attend the hearing. The hearing proceeded in their absence in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 7-8 knots of wind and a slight sea state.
Prior to the starting sequence of race 1, the race committee reminded competitors that RRS 40.1 was active, announcing it on VHF channel 17.
VHF channel 17 was the official channel used by the race committee to communicate with the competitors.
During the first rounding of the leeward gate mark in race 1, Tobi Schrage, a crew member of GER 923, and all crew members on GER 926 were not wearing a personal flotation device.
conclusions: Tobi Schrage, a competitor on GER 923, and all competitors on GER 926 failed to wear a personal flotation device as required by RRS 40.2 and NoR 1.3, and broke RRS 40.1.
decision: GER 923 and GER 926 are to be scored DSQ in Race 1.
